note: Per-campaign Platform x Placement DAILY series over the 14-day window (including today), from Meta Insights with breakdowns=publisher_platform,platform_position. Each campaign carries placements[] ({platform, position, daily[]}); each daily row: date, spendUSD, impressions, clicks, ctrPct, cpmUSD, purchases.
